visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots feature a golden-brown, elongated pastry topped with pink cream and crushed pistachios on a pink ceramic tray. Small glowing particles float in the air. (2) A man with long dark hair wearing a striped beige-and-brown shirt stands in a bright kitchen studio, holding up pink bags of freeze-dried strawberry products. (3) Hands pour strawberries into milk, which are then blended into a thick pink puree using a hand blender in a plastic container. (4) In a close-up, sugar, egg yolks, flour, and hot milk are whisked in a glass bowl, then cooked in a pan until thick. (5) Puff pastry dough is prepared in a pot, mixed with eggs using an electric mixer, and piped into long strips on a baking tray. (6) White meringue with almond nibs is spread over the strips before they are baked in a professional oven at 190 and 170 degrees. (7) The baked puffs are filled with pink cream and topped with sliced dried strawberries. The man and a masked woman taste the dessert, expressing joy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy acoustic guitar strumming and a steady drum beat establish a fast, cheerful pop atmosphere. A male narrator begins speaking with high vocal arousal and clear articulation, emphasizing the 'crisp' texture of the dessert. (2) A sharp whirring sound of a hand blender triggers a shift, layered over the continuous upbeat BGM. The narrator's speech rate is rapid, matching the instructional montage. (3) Rhythmic whisking sounds and the metallic clink of a spoon against glass are heard as the narrator explains ingredients. The vocal tone is friendly and authoritative. (4) The low-frequency mechanical hum of an electric hand mixer becomes prominent, followed by a soft bubbling sound of liquid on a stove. (5) A crisp, percussive 'crunch' sound occurs as someone bites into the pastry, accompanied by faint laughter and a joyful exclamation from a female voice. (6) The music swells slightly with a digital 'ding' sound effect for the final brand endorsement, maintaining the bright spectral centroid until the fade-out.
